lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਕਰਿ ਰੰਙੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man har raam naam kar ra(n)ng ||
lines.translation: O my mind, enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਰਾਉ ਨਿਸੰਙੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur tuthai har upadesiaa har bhetiaa raau nisa(n)ng ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru, satisfied and pleased, taught me about the Lord, and my Sovereign Lord King met with me at once. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਇਆਣੀ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਅੰਙੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dh iaanee manamukhee phir aavan jaanaa a(n)ng ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is like the ignorant bride, who comes and goes again and again in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਸਹਲੰਙੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh chit na aaio man doojaa bhaau sahala(n)ng ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord God does not come into her consciousness, and her mind is stuck in the love of duality. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅੰਗੀ ਅੰਙੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham mail bhare duhachaareeaa har raakhahu a(n)gee a(n)ng ||
lines.translation: I am full of filth, and I practice evil deeds; O Lord, save me, be with me, merge me into Your Being!

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਨਵਲਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਥੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪੰਙੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur a(n)mrit sar navalaaiaa sabh laathe kilavikh pa(n)ng ||3||
lines.translation: The Guru has bathed me in the pool of Ambrosial Nectar, and all my dirty sins and mistakes have been washed away. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੰਙੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har deenaa deen daiaal prabh satasa(n)gat melahu sa(n)ng ||
lines.translation: O Lord God, Merciful to the meek and the poor, please unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰੰਙੁ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mil sa(n)gat har ra(n)g paaiaa jan naanak man tan ra(n)ng ||4||3||
lines.translation: Joining the Sangat, servant Nanak has obtained the Lord's Love; my mind and body are drenched in it. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har karahi nit kapat kamaavahi hiradaa sudh na hoee ||
lines.translation: One who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, while constantly practicing deception, shall never become pure of heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anadin karam karahi bahutere supanai sukh na hoee ||1||
lines.translation: He may perform all sorts of rituals, night and day, but he shall not find peace, even in dreams. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaanee gur bin bhagat na hoee ||
lines.translation: O wise ones, without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੜੈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: korai ra(n)g kade na chaRai je lochai sabh koee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The untreated cloth does not take up the dye, no matter how much everyone may wish it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਵਰਤ ਕਰੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sa(n)jam varat kare poojaa manamukh rog na jaaee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh may perform chants, meditations, austere self-discipline, fasts and devotional worship, but his sickness does not go away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਹਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar rog mahaa abhimaanaa doojai bhaai khuaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Deep within him is the sickness of excessive egotism; in the love of duality he is ruined. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮਨੂਆ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: baahar bhekh bahut chaturaaee manooaa dah dis dhaavai ||
lines.translation: Outwardly, he wears religious robes and he is very clever, but his mind wanders in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਆਪਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: haumai biaapiaa sabad na cheenhai phir phir joonee aavai ||3||
lines.translation: Engrossed in ego, he does not remember the Word of the Shabad; over and over again, he is reincarnated. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar kare so boojhai so jan naam dhiaae ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, that mortal who is blessed with the Lord's Glance of Grace, understands Him; that humble servant meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee eko boojhai ekas maahi samaae ||4||4||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, he understands the One Lord, and is absorbed into the One Lord. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat nagaree khoj khojaaee ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I searched and searched the body-village;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam padaarath paaee ||1||
lines.translation: I found the wealth of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man har har saa(n)t vasaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, has enshrined peace within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tisanaa agan bujhee khin a(n)tar gur miliai sabh bhukh gavaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The fire of desire was extinguished in an instant, when I met the Guru; all my hunger has been satisfied. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavaa jeevaa meree maaee ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I live, O my mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur daiaal gun naam driRaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The Merciful True Guru implanted the Glorious Praises of the Naam within me. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਢੂਢਿ ਢੂਢਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau har prabh piaaraa dhoodh dhoodhaaee ||
lines.translation: I search for and seek out my Beloved Lord God, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil har ras paaee ||3||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have obtained the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur masatak lekh likhe har paaee ||
lines.translation: By the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead, I have found the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa melai har bhaaee ||4||1||5||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak, pleased and satisfied, has united me with the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kripaa kare man har ra(n)g laae ||
lines.translation: Showering His Mercy, the Lord imbues the mind with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh har har naam samaae ||1||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh merges in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g raataa man ra(n)g maane ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, the mortal enjoys the pleasure of His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee poore gur kai sabad samaane ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He remains always blissful, day and night, and he merges into the Shabad, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਕਉ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g kau lochai sabh koee ||
lines.translation: Everyone longs for the Lord's Love;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਲੂਲਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ra(n)g chaloolaa hoee ||2||
lines.translation: the Gurmukh is imbued with the deep red color of His Love. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਗਧੁ ਨਰੁ ਕੋਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mugadh nar koraa hoi ||
lines.translation: The foolish, self-willed manmukh is left pale and uncolored.
